title: 第6 章 收获满满-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    现在的北海不像后世那么金碧辉煌，十步一景，百步一阁。说是破败不堪夸张了，只能说现在的人饭都吃不饱，哪有力气逛公园呀！北海现在最大的作用就是钓鱼。

    这个点儿，北海公园已经有很多人在湖边钓鱼，王野带着王江河找到一个人少的地方，组装好鱼竿儿，正准备钓鱼，王野暗呼一声：“我艹（一种草本植物）忘了鱼饵了。”

    这要是让人看到王野不用鱼饵都能钓上鱼来，那乐子就大了。

    来都来了，还能回去了，带着王江河来到树根下，找了根小木棍开始挖蚯蚓，还好现在还没饿到连蚯蚓都吃的地步。没一会儿就挖到了好几条。王野让王江河继续挖，自己去钓鱼了。

    甩出鱼钩，精神力顺着鱼线观察水里的情况，鱼还是不少的。毕竟北海公园禁止捕捞，这也算是给很多四九城人留了一条生机。这还客气啥，收吧！小的不要，一条，两条.....没十分钟就收了七八十条，没有一条是低于五斤。

    空间里够用了，接下来就是装A和C之间的时间，三五分钟就钓上一条，钓一条就装在鱼篓里。没一会儿，王野就又发现问题了，鱼篓太小了，装不下了。

    王野心想：“当我那么多小说白看了呀！”

    在周围找了一些藤蔓，钓一条就把鱼从鱼鳃里穿过去，绑上，让王江河拿到一边看着，流水线作业，基本上保证五分钟一条。

    开始还没什么，过了一会儿，周围的人越来越多。看周围的动静，王野知道不能继续钓了，得想办法处理这些鱼。

    众人见王野收起鱼竿儿，都围了过来七嘴八舌的说：“小兄弟，你这鱼卖吗？我出高价。”

    王野笑着说：“各位叔叔大爷，现在的政策咱都知道，我这鱼肯定是不会卖的，作为新时代的一员，我们要紧跟D的领导，巴拉巴拉......（此处省略一千字）所以我这鱼不卖，只换。”

    就听见有人嘀咕道：“这孩子真TMD贫。”

    王野接着又喊了一句：“我这儿来者不拒，什么都行。”

    这七嘴八舌的，一会儿有拿粮票的，有拿布票的，有拿糖票的，五花八门什么都有。没一会儿，四十多条鱼就被换没了。

    王江河看着一条条鱼被拿走，委屈的问：“大哥，鱼都被换没了，咱们不吃吗？”

    王野拍了一下他的小脑袋：“你个傻小子，这才一上午咱就钓了这么多，下午不得再多钓点呀，下午钓的再带回家。”

    正在王野跟王江河解释的时候，远处跑来一个衣着光鲜的中年人，气喘吁吁的问：“小伙子，看见这儿有卖鱼的了吗？”

    王野郑重的说：“大叔，你可不许瞎说呀！这儿哪有卖鱼的。”

    中年男人着急地摆摆手：“哎呀，小伙子，我不是来找茬的。我是罐头厂采购部的，听说这边有人钓到好多鱼，就是你吧？我这不想着能不能买点回去给工人们尝尝鲜。既然不能买，那用东西换总行吧？我那儿有不少稀罕物件。”

    王野一听，来了兴趣问道：“大叔，啥稀罕物件？说来听听。”

    中年男人忙不迭说道：“我那有罐头，糖，水果，都是市面上少见的，我们的罐头都是出口的。”

    王野眼珠一转：“行，大叔，那咱们就换。不过得等下午了，下午我们再钓些鱼就跟您换。”

    中年男人大喜过望：“好好好，小伙子，那我就在这儿等着你们。”

    王江河拉了拉王野的衣角，小声说：“大哥，那些东西真那么好吗？”

    王野“嘿嘿”一笑：“放心吧！肯定值。今天咱们可是收获满满啊！”

    于是，午后阳光正好的时候，两人又开始垂钓，准备换取更多的好东西。

    一转眼就到了四点多，中午都是中年男人去国营饭店买的干粮。这一下午是收获满满，六十多条大大小小的各种鱼。

    中年男人中间回去了一趟工厂，叫来了好几位帮手，起来了一辆平板三轮，还带着两个个大木桶，这就方便王野发挥了。

    这一下午，王野胳膊都抡酸了：“大叔，差不多了吧，我实在钓不动了。”

    中年男人带着遗憾的回道：“行吧！不少了，我不是觉得多多益善嘛！走，咱回工厂。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Today’s Beihai is not as splendid as in later generations. Every ten steps has a scene, and every hundred steps has a pavilion.To say it is dilapidated is an exaggeration. It can only be said that people nowadays don’t have enough to eat, so how can they have the energy to go to the park?The biggest role of the North Sea now is fishing.

At this point, there were already many people fishing by the lake in Beihai Park. Wang Ye took Wang Jianghe to find a place with few people, assembled the fishing rods, and were about to fish. Wang Ye secretly exclaimed: "Fuck (a kind of herb), I forgot the bait."

“It would be great fun if people could see that Wang Ye could catch fish without using bait.

Having come here, I can still go back. I took Wang Jianghe to the root of the tree, found a small stick and started digging for earthworms. Fortunately, I was not hungry enough to eat earthworms yet.It didn’t take long to dig out several of them.Wang Ye asked Wang Jianghe to continue digging and went fishing by himself.

Throw out the hook and follow the fishing line mentally to observe the situation in the water. There are still a lot of fish.After all, fishing is prohibited in Beihai Park, which gives many people in Sijiu City a chance to survive.Why are you so polite? Just take it!No need for small ones, one piece, two pieces... I collected seventy or eighty pieces in less than ten minutes, and none weighed less than five kilograms.

There is enough space, so the next step is to install A and C. You can catch one in three to five minutes and put it in the fish basket after catching one.After a while, Wang Ye discovered another problem. The fish basket was too small to fit in.

Wang Ye thought: "I think I have read so many novels in vain!"

I found some vines around, and when I caught one, I passed the fish through its gills, tied it up, and let Wang Jianghe take it aside to watch. The assembly line operation basically guarantees one fish every five minutes.

It was nothing at first, but after a while, more and more people were around.Looking at the movement around him, Wang Ye knew that he could no longer continue fishing and had to find a way to deal with these fish.

When everyone saw Wang Ye put away his fishing rod, they all gathered around and said, "Little brother, do you want to sell this fish? I'll pay a high price."

Wang Ye smiled and said: "Dear uncles and uncles, we all know the current policy. My fish will definitely not be sold. As a member of the new era, we must closely follow the leadership of D, blah blah... (omitting a thousand words here), so I will not sell my fish, only exchange it."

I heard someone muttering: "This kid is so damn poor."

Wang Ye then shouted: "I won't refuse anyone who comes here, anything is acceptable."

Among these chattering people, some were getting food stamps, some were getting cloth stamps, some were getting candy stamps, there were all kinds of things.After a while, more than 40 fish were replaced.

Wang Jianghe watched the fish being taken away one by one, and asked aggrievedly: "Brother, all the fish have been replaced, why don't we eat?"

Wang Ye patted his little head: "You silly boy, we have caught so much in the morning, we must not catch more in the afternoon, we will take what we catch home in the afternoon."

While Wang Ye was explaining to Wang Jianghe, a well-dressed middle-aged man ran up from a distance and asked breathlessly: "Young man, have you seen a fish seller here?"

Wang Ye said solemnly: "Uncle, you are not allowed to talk nonsense! There is no fish seller here."

The middle-aged man waved his hands anxiously: "Hey, young man, I'm not here to cause trouble. I work in the purchasing department of the cannery. I heard that someone caught a lot of fish here, is it you? I'm wondering if I can buy some back for the workers to try. Since I can't buy it, how about exchanging it with the head office? I have a lot of rare items there."

When Wang Ye heard this, he became interested and asked: "Uncle, what is this rare object? Tell me about it."

The middle-aged man hurriedly said: "I have cans, sugar, and fruits, which are rare on the market. Our cans are all exported."

Wang Ye rolled his eyes: "Okay, uncle, let's switch. But we have to wait until the afternoon. We will trade with you if we catch some fish in the afternoon."

The middle-aged man was overjoyed: "Okay, okay, young man, then I will wait for you here."

Wang Jianghe tugged on Wang Ye's clothes and whispered, "Brother, are those things really that good?"

Wang Ye smiled "hehe": "Don't worry! It's definitely worth it. We have gained a lot today!"

So, when the sunshine was just right in the afternoon, the two started fishing again, preparing to exchange for more good things.

It was past four o’clock in the blink of an eye, and middle-aged men went to the state-owned restaurant to buy dry food at noon.This afternoon was a fruitful one, with more than 60 fish of various sizes.

The middle-aged man went back to the factory, called several helpers, and set up a flat-bed three-wheeler with two large wooden barrels, which made it easier for Wang Ye to perform.

This afternoon, Wang Ye’s arms were sore: “Uncle, it’s almost done, I really can’t catch it anymore.”

The middle-aged man replied with regret: "Okay! It's quite a lot. I think the more the merrier! Come on, let's go back to the factory."
Page (1/3)
